title: Shiksha Hi Surakhya
desc: A clarion call for transformative action, safeguarding underprivileged children against child labor, early marriage, and trafficking through quality schooling, material supply, and safety training.

title: Blood Donation Camps
desc: Blood has a short shelf-life and supply is constantly required for surgeries, cancer treatments, and accidents. Join our regular donation camps and fill out our consent form to be notified of upcoming drives.

title: Organ Donation Awareness
desc: Help save lives and end suffering for machine-dependent patients. Raising awareness, debunking myths, and providing resources for pledge card registration. Let's make human kindness eternal.

title: Plantation & Sustainability
desc: Planting trees sequestrates carbon, purifies air, prevents soil erosion, and preserves biodiversity. Participate in our community reforestation projects and build a legacy for our children.

title: Social Welfare & Mental Health
motto: Together We Grow, Together We Heal
desc: Advocating for secure Social Security channels and spreading awareness on Child and Adolescent Mental Health (ADHD, Anxiety, Depression). Providing counselor linkages to prevent self-harm.
